aboutH2: OAR Wellness: Inpatient Addiction and Mental Health Care Near Palgrave
intro: OAR Wellness is a private wellness and addiction treatment centre in Ontario dedicated to helping individuals build a healthier, more stable future beyond addiction and mental health challenges. With a trauma-informed and evidence-based approach, OAR Wellness provides personalized inpatient treatment programs designed to support long-term recovery, emotional resilience, and sustainable lifestyle changes. Their team brings more than 70 years of combined clinical experience in addiction recovery, mental health care, and wellness-focused rehabilitation.

Located in a discreet and peaceful setting near Toronto, OAR Wellness focuses on treating both substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health conditions such as anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD, and ADHD. Their programs combine structured therapy, life skills development, fitness, nutrition, emotional regulation, and discharge planning to help clients successfully transition back into everyday life with confidence and support.

pillars.title: A Private, Forested Property in South Simcoe
pillars.body: OAR Wellness is on a quiet rural property in Adjala-Tosorontio, at the southern edge of Simcoe County, about an hour from Toronto and a short drive from Tottenham, Bolton and Alliston. The centre describes it as a retreat rather than a hospital. Bedrooms are private or shared, and there are lounges, group rooms and private therapy rooms. Outside, a pond and tall trees surround the house, with room to walk. Meals are cooked on site, and yoga, movement and mindfulness sessions happen on the property. Admissions sends directions once your start date is confirmed.

pillars.title: A Written Plan Before You Go Home
pillars.body: Planning for discharge starts in your first week. By the time you leave you will have a written plan that covers where you will live, who is supporting you, the situations most likely to trigger a relapse and what to do if you need more help. The team connects you with SMART Recovery or 12-step groups, online meetings, an outpatient therapist and a doctor for follow-up. Alumni groups and check-ins with the team continue after discharge, families get aftercare support for up to 30 days, and there is a direct route back into inpatient care if things get hard. The centre is upfront that recovery usually takes two to three years, and it sees the inpatient stay as the first stage.

pillars.title: Graduate-Level Clinicians and a Weekly Family Program
pillars.body: Every clinician at OAR Wellness holds a master's degree or higher, with training in CBT, DBT, CPT, EMDR, IFS and other trauma-focused therapies, and the team has close to 70 years of combined experience. The program is for men and women aged 25 and older, many of them working professionals, students and parents. Families are part of treatment when the client agrees. A family team member calls within 24 hours of admission, and families then get 12 hours of programming a month, a four-week education course and a group session every Sunday afternoon followed by a visit.

overview: What sets OAR Wellness apart is its realistic, forward-focused philosophy toward recovery. Rather than offering quick fixes, the centre emphasizes long-term healing through individualized care, family involvement, and practical strategies that help clients rebuild routines, relationships, and overall well-being. Their compassionate and highly experienced clinicians work closely with each individual to create a personalized recovery path in a safe, supportive, and judgment-free environment.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does OAR Wellness cost?
faqs.a: OAR Wellness does not publish its prices, so admissions quotes current fees on a confidential call. It is a private, fee-for-service program that takes private payment and select insurance plans. For eligible clients who cannot afford the full fee, there are community beds and, where possible, sliding-scale payment.

faqs.q: How long is the program at OAR Wellness?
faqs.a: Inpatient stays usually run from 30 to 90 days, and the recommended length is discussed during your assessment. The centre treats the stay as the foundation and describes recovery as a two to three year process, with aftercare planned before you leave.

No, OAR Wellness does not provide medical detox on site. If you need withdrawal management, the team coordinates a referral to a medical facility and plans your admission for once you are medically stable.

faqs.q: Where is OAR Wellness and how do I get there?
faqs.a: OAR Wellness is at 7826 5 Sideroad in Adjala-Tosorontio, with a Palgrave mailing address, in the south end of Simcoe County. It is about an hour's drive from Toronto and around 15 minutes from Tottenham and Bolton. Clients and families arrange their own transport, and new clients arrive on a Monday.

faqs.q: What happens after I leave OAR Wellness?
faqs.a: You leave with a written discharge and relapse-prevention plan that covers housing, supports, triggers and what to do if you struggle. The team links you with SMART Recovery or 12-step groups, an outpatient therapist and a doctor for follow-up. Alumni groups and check-ins continue after discharge, and there is a clear route back to inpatient care if you need it.

faqs.q: Is OAR Wellness private? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, OAR Wellness is a private, fee-for-service centre and OHIP does not usually cover private residential treatment. Some extended health benefits and employer plans reimburse part of the cost. The centre gives detailed receipts, helps you check what your plan covers and can coordinate with an EAP.

faqs.q: What services does OAR Wellness provide?
faqs.a: OAR Wellness offers private addiction treatment, inpatient rehab programs, mental health support, trauma-informed therapy, relapse prevention, counselling, and holistic wellness services tailored to individual recovery needs.

faqs.q: What types of addiction does OAR Wellness treat?
faqs.a: OAR Wellness supports individuals struggling with alcohol addiction, drug addiction, prescription medication dependency, and co-occurring mental health conditions such as anxiety, depression, PTSD, and ADHD.

faqs.q: Is treatment at OAR Wellness personalized?
faqs.a: Yes. Every client receives a customized treatment plan based on their personal history, recovery goals, mental health needs, and lifestyle factors. The team focuses on long-term healing and sustainable recovery strategies.

faqs.q: Does OAR Wellness offer confidential addiction treatment?
faqs.a: Absolutely. OAR Wellness provides a safe, private, and judgment-free environment where clients can focus on recovery with complete confidentiality and professional support.

faqs.q: Why choose OAR Wellness for addiction and mental health treatment?
faqs.a: OAR Wellness stands out for its experienced clinical team, evidence-based therapies, holistic approach to recovery, and commitment to helping clients achieve lasting wellness through personalized care and ongoing support.

faqs.q: Who is the OAR Wellness program for?
faqs.a: OAR Wellness treats men and women aged 25 and older, and the centre says many of its clients have careers or families affected by their substance use. It does not treat eating disorders, psychosis or sexual behaviour disorders, and it refers people to better-suited services when it is not the right fit.
